_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 45: 13-24 January 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is not about being mega but about being like Jesus, thanks God for godly principles and godly theology and godly thinking, and says they believe God is not done with America yet.
mentions.quote: It's not about being mega. It's about being like Jesus
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is the same standard he applied to the mega minister in December.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says that if they do not know him they are in trouble but tonight is the night of salvation, and repeats that the shoes put on to go to work today might be taken off by the undertaker tonight because they do not know if tonight is their night.
mentions.quote: tonight's the night of salvation
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He points to things already happening in the news concerning major weather events and refers back to what the Lord showed them on November the 11th, when he saw a major ice storm coming to America that he describes as engineered.
mentions.quote: I saw a major ice storm coming to America
mentions.falsify_match: A major American ice storm after 11 November 2025. The original telling is in this corpus and can be read directly.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such storm, or the 11 November video does not say what he says it says.

mentions.claim_text: He says what the Lord showed them concerning the ice storm was on November the 11th, asks to be corrected if wrong, plays the clip, and quotes the Lord telling them they are about to see weather.
mentions.quote: YOU'RE ABOUT TO see weat
mentions.falsify_match: He plays the original recording on air, so the claim is checked in front of the audience.
mentions.falsify_miss: The clip does not say it.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the president pointing to the arrests and to the success of his presidency over one year, and says he had such a caution about all that is about to take place, recalling that the Lord told him about the next period.
mentions.quote: I had such a caution about all that's about to take place
mentions.falsify_match: A reversal following the first year's claimed successes.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. A caution with no content attached to it.

mentions.claim_text: He says he believes 2026 will be a year for their intimate relationship with the father, and that what was dry in their life through the past will become a great river of growth, like a tree planted by the water.
mentions.quote: in 2026 it'll be a year for your intimate relationship with the father
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says this is either a make or break time for the president's term, and that the decisions in the valley of decisions where he is right now will make or break the 2026 midterms and be the deciding factor.
mentions.quote: the decisions in the valley of the decisions will make or break the election
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as stated: make or break covers both outcomes and the decisions are not specified.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says he believes it is a right on word that the man is two-faced and big-headed and that the Lord is warning about this, and adds that he is not there to pick on people and judge their character but to pray it away.
mentions.quote: he's two-faced. He's big-headed. The Lord is warning about this
mentions.falsify_match: A public betrayal by the man in question.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He is not named here, and the disclaimer about not judging character arrives immediately after the character judgment.

mentions.claim_text: He says he truly believes with all his heart that what the Lord showed them about the tariffs will prove accurate, that it is tomorrow which is the 20th, and that it is probably already decided by now.
mentions.quote: what he has showed us about the tariffs. That's tomorrow which is the 20th
mentions.falsify_match: A tariff decision on 20 January 2026 matching what he says was shown.
mentions.falsify_miss: No decision, or one that does not match. What was shown is not restated here, which is the weakness.

mentions.claim_text: He thanks God that 1 Corinthians 5:5 was said to be the year anthem of 2026 and would run clear into 2027 and 2028, and that God said he would shake the nations, shaking them for three years.
mentions.quote: I'm going to shake the nations for three years
mentions.falsify_match: Three years of global upheaval.
mentions.falsify_miss: Three quiet years. Shaking is undefined everywhere in the corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He says demonic spirits are sent as a distraction to bring glory to themselves and cause confusion, that AI will be used for exactly the same things, and that they will not know the difference between real and fake, authentic and fake, and that it is coming.
mentions.quote: You'll not know the difference between real and fake
mentions.falsify_match: Synthetic media becoming indistinguishable from real footage.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. This is already broadly true when he says it, so the claim is behind the technology rather than ahead of it.

mentions.claim_text: He says there are more with them than there are with the others, that whatever army they have, a billion or a hundred million, there are more angels with them, and that he does not care how many soldiers China's army has.
mentions.quote: there are more with you than there are with them
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an angelic count against a military one.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He reports people telling him they do not believe they will lose any seats in the House or the Senate and that there will be a landslide home run again just like 2024, repeated for 2026.
mentions.quote: I just don't believe that we'll lose any kind of seats
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: his audience's expectation, quoted so he can disagree with it.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says the services are not for goosebumps and tickles but to bring in the harvest one last time, that they have been anticipating great things and that creative miracles and signs and wonders will follow those who believe.
mentions.quote: This is not for goosebumps and tickles, but to bring in the harvest
mentions.falsify_match: Verified creative miracles in the services.
mentions.falsify_miss: None reported.

mentions.claim_text: He says it does not have to sound like his language, that it will sound like what the Holy Ghost is telling them and will come out of them sounding different, and tells them to add their supply because as they add it they bring something.
mentions.quote: It's going to sound different. But add your supply
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He recommends Brother Hagin's teachings, saying they help him and he listened today to the authority of the believer, and that he needs refreshers all the time.
mentions.quote: Listen to Brother Hagen teachings. They help you. They help me
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: names the tradition his teaching comes out of, which is useful for placing the rest.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: They work through the arithmetic from Biden to Trump, saying they would still have this year and then next year to make a full seven years of tribulation, and settle on 2027.
mentions.quote: To say it's a full seven years. Seven years of tribulation
mentions.falsify_match: The tribulation beginning in 2027.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Note the arithmetic is being worked out loud from presidential terms rather than received.

mentions.claim_text: He says they must pray for the major decisions he is about to give and for the speech he will give at the State of the Union, and says it is on the 25th or whatever of February.
mentions.quote: the State of the Union. It's on the 25th or whatever of February
mentions.falsify_match: A State of the Union on 25 February 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: It falls elsewhere. He puts the same speech on 3 February five days later, which is the point worth recording.

mentions.claim_text: He says like Sodom and Gomorrah they do not see what is coming and their eyes are not in line, citing Ephesians 1:18 that the eyes of their understanding are not enlightened and they have no understanding.
mentions.quote: the eyes of their understanding are not enlightened
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it disqualifies disagreement in advance: those who do not see are described as unable to.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He thanks God that angels were sent there and are protecting the truth tellers, and notes they have things they may not say.
mentions.quote: the angels of the Lord are protecting the truth tellers
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says that when he saw Minnesota and the corruption this is part of the door, an exposing concerning the vote, corrects himself from red states to a blue state exposing, and says this is what will cause the pivotal.
mentions.quote: an exposing concerning the vote in the blue state
mentions.falsify_match: Election fraud findings in a blue state.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He corrects red to blue mid-sentence, which is worth keeping.

mentions.claim_text: He says there was a bad way of thinking through their government and politics that is trying to get a stronghold through their leaders, that they do not have the right leaders and to pray for them, and that it is an infiltration coming from China.
mentions.quote: It's an infiltration from China coming
mentions.falsify_match: Documented Chinese political influence operations.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Which country's leaders are meant is not clear from this passage.

mentions.claim_text: He plays the president saying he has expressed that he would be very unhappy if the man did that and does not think he will, and a reporter asking whether that sets a precedent.
mentions.quote: I would be very unhappy if he did that
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: a played press exchange.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told them to watch over this timeframe which goes up until the 26th and then to watch the 3rd of February, and recalls saying the third will smell like a turd, calling it grotesque.
mentions.quote: Watch the 3rd of February. The third will smell like a turd
mentions.falsify_match: Something bad on 3 February 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: The date passes quietly. Seventh thing attached to that date, and the rhyme is the only content.

mentions.claim_text: He says he talked about going into the 3rd of February and praying over that timeframe before the Olympics start on the 6th, which is why the Olympics is in the background, praying over a black swan event, and describes a huge black swan floating down.
mentions.quote: praying over a black swan event. It was a huge black swan floating down
mentions.falsify_match: An unforeseen major event around the Olympic opening.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He now has the games opening on the 6th, which is correct.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is thinking about January 3rd, repeating the third, notes that he sees in part and hears in part, and says he finds it interesting because Maduro was captured on the 3rd while he had seen the third repeated.
mentions.quote: Maduro was captured on the 3rd, but I saw the third, the third
mentions.falsify_match: A capture on 3 January 2026 and prior tellings naming the third. Both halves are checkable and the tellings are in this corpus.
mentions.falsify_miss: The date is wrong, or no prior telling names the third. Note the earlier tellings pointed at February the 3rd.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a technology used during this that turns the volume down so it does not make everybody go bloody everywhere, allows that maybe there are strengths to it and that he does not know, and says he saw this on July the 6th of 2014.
mentions.quote: turning the volume down so it doesn't make everybody go bloody
mentions.falsify_match: An acoustic or directed energy crowd control system in use.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The 2014 date is outside this corpus and cannot be checked here.

mentions.claim_text: He says five major shakings are coming to this world, in the earth, in politics, in the heavens, in the church and in finances, and that it is time to come to Christ because they are running out of time.
mentions.quote: Five major shakings is coming to this world
mentions.falsify_match: Upheaval across all five domains.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The five domains between them cover everything that could happen.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are twelve days into it and barely scratching the surface of 2026, that they hear all this prophetic chatter, and tells them to find God for themselves, turn YouTube off and listen to what the voice of the Lord is telling them.
mentions.quote: Find God for yourself. Turn YouTube off
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it cuts against his own interest, which is worth recording.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a
